channel.description: Latest articles from Just A Pinch Recipes (justapinch.com)

item.title: Favorite Green Bean Casserole
item.description: We don't think a holiday meal is complete without green bean casserole on the table. This recipe adds Velveeta to the cream of mushroom soup with adds nice flavor and creaminess. There's just enough bacon and mushrooms in every bite. This bakes to bubbly perfection with a nice golden top. We made this in a 9x13 dish, but think a 2 quart would work better. This is for a small gathering but can easily be doubled.

item.title: Bourbon and Chocolate Pecan Pie
item.description: This is a pecan pie brought to the next level with the addition of chocolate and bourbon. The addition of bourbon blends well with the chocolate and pecans. Once baked, the outside is crystallized and crunchy while the inside is nice and gooey, as you'd expect in a pecan pie. If you love the flavor of bourbon, it will be a great addition to your holiday dessert menu.

item.title: Sweet Milk Dinner Rolls
item.description: These sweet milk dinner rolls have a slight sweetness balanced by a little saltiness. They're an easy dinner roll that can be hand-kneaded or made in a stand mixer. We're all about the mixer doing the hard work. Light and fluffy, make these rolls for Sunday dinner or alongside a holiday dinner.

item.title: Italian Christmas Quiche
item.description: This is one yummy quiche with tons of flavor. The Italian seasoning goes great with the mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses. Chunks of meat and asparagus make this a hearty quiche. It's simple to make and will be a delicious holiday breakfast or brunch.

item.title: Easy Cheesy Creamed Spinach With Garlic
item.description: Lauren's cheesy creamed spinach with garlic is just as good as something you'd order at a fancy steakhouse. The sauce is thick, creamy, and full of garlic. Parmesan cheese adds a robust flavor to the cream sauce. This fresh creamed spinach is easy to make and, since it has a fancy feel, would make a wonderful holiday side dish.

item.title: Baked Creamed Potatoes
item.description: We love the cooking technique for these baked creamed potatoes. They taste exactly like scalloped potatoes. Once baked, the cubed potatoes are slightly crispy outside, while the inside is soft. The milk and cream seep into the potatoes making the dish rich and creamy. These potatoes are a good holiday side dish option because the recipe can be multiplied to feed a crowd.

item.title: Crock Pot Cheesy Scalloped Potatoes and Ham
item.description: We made the Kicked Up creamy version of this recipe and that is just exactly what it was. We like that this is cooked in the Crock Pot... makes for a very easy meal. Great if you have leftover holiday ham. The cheese sauce is just enough... it's so good!

item.title: Hot Bacon Cheese Spread
item.description: After one bite, we could see why this hot bacon cheese spread is so popular. Warm and super cheesy, there are bits of bacon in every bite, adding a wonderful smoky flavor. Onions add a nice pop of sweetness next to the savory Colby Jack cheese and bacon. Preparing it in a bread bowl makes for a pretty presentation and slightly elevates this simple dip for the holidays. Make sure to have crackers handy for dipping because you'll want to enjoy every last bit of this hot bacon dip.

item.title: Crab Dip
item.description: Rich and savory, we couldn't stop eating this crab dip. It's creamy and cheesy with crab throughout. Super easy to make, serve with pita chips, celery, or a buttery cracker for a wonderful appetizer. This is on the saltier side, though. If needed, slightly cut back on the garlic salt and onion salt. It will still be delicious!

item.title: Sauerkraut and Pork for New Year's Day
item.description: We loved this recipe for sauerkraut pork chops because it's easy to make, and the result is delicious. The pork is tender and juicy. Sauerkraut adds a tangy and savory flavor to the dish. Broth helps to keep the pork moist. Super tender, the pork can be cut with a fork. It's a hearty and satisfying meal that'll make you feel cozy and happy. We used the original scrumptious recipe and browned the meat directly in the Instant Pot on the saute setting.
